items.title: File Widerspruch against the account-clarification decision
items.quote: Den Widerspruch gegen diese Entscheidung richten Sie innerhalb eines Monats ab ihrer Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift an die Rentenversicherung Musterküste, Kontenweg 18, 23560 Beispielbeck.
items.computation: Letter dated Wed 27.08.2025 is a postal letter from a social-insurance authority. Under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X it counts as delivered (bekannt gegeben) on the 4th day after posting: 27.08. + 4 days = Sun 31.08.2025; for authority post this day does not shift even though it falls on a Sunday. The one-month Widerspruch period of § 84 Abs. 1 SGG starts the next day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB): 01.09.2025. One month later, per § 188 Abs. 3 BGB, ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the day of the event's calendar correspondence, i.e. 30.09.2025 (since 31.09 does not exist, it falls on the month's last day). Tue 30.09.2025 is a normal working day in NW, so no further shift under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X applies.

warnings: The letter also mentions a period (01.07.2006–31.12.2006) that was not credited because no evidence was submitted, and invites Mr. Musterschmidt to submit documents for re-review ("Reichen Sie Unterlagen nach, prüfen wir das gern erneut"); no deadline is given for this, so it is not listed as a dated item — but it is not a legal obligation, just an option, and missing it only risks that period staying uncredited.
